faqs.q: Sec. 42-38. - I.F.C. Section 109.1, Board of appeals established.
faqs.a:
Section 109.1. Board of appeals established,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"109.1. Board of appeals established.
In order to hear and decide appeals of orders, decisions, or determinations made
                  by the fire code official relative to the application and interpretation of this code,
                  there is hereby created a board of appeals. The board of appeals shall be known as
                  the
Building Code Advisory Board (BCAB).
The BCAB shall be appointed by the governing body and shall hold office at its pleasure.
                  The fire code official of the responsible fire district shall be an ex-officio member
                  of said board but shall not vote on any matter before the board. Rules of procedure
                  for conducting the Board's business shall be as set forth in
section 18-36
of the administrative code, as amended, in Article II
Chapter 18
of the Arvada City Code."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
